dialogues.speaker: L'or noir
dialogues.text: This board is for public announcements. 50 Mora each. If you have any questions or needs leave a message with reception.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Soup Kitchen
dialogues.text: The Soup Kitchen needs two helpers to handle odd jobs. The salary is 1,120 Mora per day and paid out daily. Lunch and dinner included.

dialogues.speaker: Soup Kitchen
dialogues.text: Requirements: Able to count and handle bills, prefer applicants who look fierce and tough. Ask at the Soup Kitchen for details.

dialogues.speaker: Houard-Robere Tools Workshop
dialogues.text: We offer all kinds of mechanical customization, installation, modification, and maintenance services. We also sell some "special" weapons, and we welcome all "gentlemen" who wish to come and make purchases.

dialogues.speaker: Houard-Robere Tools Workshop
dialogues.text: We also buy used mechanical components and scrap. Excellent prices.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: Have you run into legal trouble? Do you need legal assistance? Look no farther than our legal consultation office, your most trusted "friend" in the Fleuve Cendre.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: Consultation fees starting at 1,000 Mora per minute. Please visit us for any inquiries.

dialogues.speaker: Job Recruitment
dialogues.text: Urgently recruiting two cleaners for "apartments." 200,000 Mora and four days off each month.

dialogues.speaker: Job Recruitment
dialogues.text: Requirements: A "gentleman" and "experienced." Contact Tetreaux if interested.

dialogues.speaker: Job Recruitment
dialogues.text: "Lumitoile" is hiring harvesters! No base pay, commission of 10% on all sales. Bring your own "tools."

dialogues.speaker: Sewer Hide-and-Seek Rules
dialogues.text: "Rule Number One: In Hide-and-Seek, you can only walk forwards, never backwards."

dialogues.speaker: Sewer Hide-and-Seek Rules
dialogues.text: "Rule Number Two: If you hear a dog, you must run away quickly. If you hear a cat, you must move slowly and try not to make any noise."

dialogues.speaker: Sewer Hide-and-Seek Rules
dialogues.text: "Rule Number Three: The water is poisoned, so you must not touch it lightly. Any mistakes will result in losing HP, and HP can only be regained by eating."

dialogues.speaker: Sewer Hide-and-Seek Rules
dialogues.text: "One New Rule: Areta says that sunlight is good for you, so now you can regain HP from standing in sunlight too."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Message
dialogues.text: "Excuse me, does anyone know if there's a way to restore one's rights as a citizen in Fontaine?"

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvia
dialogues.text: "As far as I know, no such cases currently exist."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Even if there was a way, it'd never happen to you, Colin. Why don't you take an honest look at what you did? That "boiler" prototype of yours razed the entire lab."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Message
dialogues.text: "It's not my fault! They must have mucked up operating it. My calculations couldn't have been wrong, it can't be my fault!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Tell it to the Oratrice, why don't you."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The Fleuve Cendre really is scary. I feel like there's shady characters everywhere."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Relax, with the Spina di Rosula here, nobody will cause too much trouble."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Really? But I saw a huge dude dressed up like an Eremite today, one glance is enough to know he means business."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "You mean Jaime the Brute, right? That's normal, his job is collecting on debts, so of course he's gotta look tough."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "He's got quite the temper though, so I'd recommend you keep your distance. He's beaten people just for looking at him twice. That's why he's called the Brute."

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Not necessarily. Today I saw old lady Bracari bump into his shoulder, and he apologized to her on the spot with perfect etiquette."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "The Brute knows how to apologize? And to an old granny? Did you drink the wrong potion?"

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Not just that, you didn't see his totally obsequious way of doing it. Just like old Colin, shrinking away like a scared finch."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Haha, definitely a pity I didn't see that!"

dialogues.speaker: Immature Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Faustier is totally ripped! How hard do I have to work to be as strong as he is?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Don't assume he was always so buff. He used to be skinny as a rail. He only became this muscular after he got sent to the Fortress of Meropide."

dialogues.speaker: Immature Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Wow! Then I want to go to the Fortress of Meropide too!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Now that's easy, all you have to do is..."

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: "Don't listen to their baloney! All you have to do is eat well, get lots of exercise, and you'll be as strong as I am!"

dialogues.speaker: Spina di Rosula
dialogues.text: All sewer residents who become ill should go to our physician, Areta.

dialogues.speaker: Areta
dialogues.text: Do not worry about costs. No additional fees will be collected.

dialogues.speaker: Transfiguration Studio
dialogues.text: The Transfiguration Studio will be constructed soon! Walk-in consultations welcome. Transfiguration, get a new face and a new life!

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Message
dialogues.text: "Transfiguration? Is that really possible?"

dialogues.speaker: Transfiguration Studio Reply
dialogues.text: "Of course it's possible! We've already completed the preliminary theoretical verification. It's just that such a dramatic and groundbreaking undertaking requires a bit more Mora to continue to achieve new breakthroughs."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Message
dialogues.text: "Really? How much Mora? Just give me a number, I'll pay it!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Come on, Colin, give it up. Such an obvious scam and you can't even tell?"

dialogues.speaker: Spina di Rosula
dialogues.text: "Lelienne, don't forget the rules here. Or do you want to be unable to stay even in the Fleuve Cendre?"

dialogues.speaker: L'or noir
dialogues.text: Follow the rules when you're on the Spina di Rosula's territory. If you have questions, ask for Tetreaux.

dialogues.speaker: Message from Tetreaux
dialogues.text: And if you do have questions, be direct and don't beat around the bush.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I've heard salvaging is really profitable! I wonder if someone like me can strike it rich too."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "You might earn no more from salvaging than fishing. As for getting rich, get real."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I've already asked around! That Crossa sells stuff that other people have salvaged! And you can tell the stuff she sells is premium!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Oh, I get it. That's the kind of 'salvage' you're talking about. No wonder."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Wait, what do you mean that kind of 'salvage'?"

dialogues.speaker: L'or noir
dialogues.text: Missing: Colin

dialogues.speaker: L'or noir
dialogues.text: A former researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute, an expert in the field of thermal energy. Strong body, weak and timid personality.

dialogues.speaker: L'or noir
dialogues.text: The individual has been missing for over a month, and has accrued a tab in the tens of thousands of Mora at the L'or noir. If anyone can provide useful information, please contact Tetreaux. We are most grateful for any information.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: I bet old Colin had the underpants scammed off of him. If you ask me, he's long gone.

dialogues.speaker: Bounty Notice
dialogues.text: The Spina di Rosula Red Notice Bounty Board. A crossed out name indicates the bounty has been resolved.

dialogues.speaker: Bounty Notice
dialogues.text: Bounty No. 11: (The name has been crossed out with red, and cannot be read)

dialogues.speaker: Bounty Notice
dialogues.text: Bounty No. 13: A notice pinned to the board with a dagger, with a giant red "X". Most of the information is now illegible, except the word "Sinthe."

dialogues.speaker: Bounty Notice
dialogues.text: Bounty No. 61: ...For selling... In violation... Boss's orders, alive or dead...

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I saw a lame local taking an outsider around here yesterday, they were talking about 'science' and 'medicine' while they were walking, what was going on?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I've also heard them say something like 'the more important the research, the more you need to do it in hidden, out-of-the-way places like this.' They're not planning on selling Sinthe, are they?"

dialogues.speaker: Message from Tetreaux
dialogues.text: "It would be best if you two would explain the situation in detail. The Boss wants to talk to them."

dialogues.speaker: A Recruitment Drive
dialogues.text: Hey! Is your life boring you to tears? Join us now! Let's unearth Dr. Mosso's mysterious legacy from thirty years ago!

dialogues.speaker: A Recruitment Drive
dialogues.text: Let me make this clear, this isn't a scam! And if you're to be any idiot, then I guarantee that you'll be the greatest idiot among idiots!

dialogues.speaker: A Recruitment Drive
dialogues.text: If you're an elite, doubtless all other elites shall find themselves wanting before you!

dialogues.speaker: A Recruitment Drive
dialogues.text: Let me repeat myself again, this is not a scam! Don't miss this golden opportunity! I'll be waiting for you at Fleuve Cendre!
